header.title: How to Replace a Dishwasher Drain Hose
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to safely replace a dishwasher drain hose. Follow these instructions to disconnect the old hose, install a new one, and restore your dishwasher's functionality.

steps.description: The first step is to disconnect the power supply to the dishwasher either by unplugging it or switching off the circuit breaker.
actions: disconnect the dishwasher's power cord from the socket
cut the circuit at the breaker box
double check that you're in the clear by trying to turn the machine on

steps.description: Detach the drain connection by unscrewing the nuts holding it in place.
actions: Locate the drain connection
Detach the connection
Unscrew the nuts

steps.description: Move the dishwasher to access the drain hose by loosening brackets and sliding the appliance out.
actions: Loosen the screws
Remove the brackets
Slide the machine out
Check the wiring

steps.description: Disconnect the drain hose from the dishwasher by squeezing the clamp and sliding it out after preparing for potential water spillage.
actions: Locate the drain hose on the bottom left-hand side of the machine.
Trace the drain hose to where it leads into the cabinet.
Place a bucket under the drain hose connection at the sink.
Place a rag under the drain hose connection at the dishwasher.
Squeeze the clamp.
Slide the hose out.

steps.description: Connect a replacement hose between the drain and the dishwasher, ensuring compatibility and a secure seal.
actions: Connect a proper replacement hose to the drain
Connect a proper replacement hose to the dishwasher
Ensure the new hose will work with your specific make and model
Clamp in the connector
Ascertain the hold of the seal

steps.description: Slide the dishwasher back into place, ensuring wires are not tangled, and secure it with brackets.
actions: Slide the dishwasher back into its original position.
Be careful with the wires.
Make sure they do not get tangled up.
Screw the brackets back in.

steps.description: Reconnect the power supply to the dishwasher and perform a test run to verify the repair.
actions: Switch the breaker to the dishwasher back on
Plug the appliance back in
Check that your repair was successful
Put the machine through a test run
